title: Three-Payment Settlement Debt-Age Bands and Their Percentage-Point Reductions
content:
# Three-Payment Settlement — Debt-Age Bands

Under Ridgeline's Settlement Agreements, the Three-Payment debt age is counted in calendar days from its anchor date up to the offer date. Where the Three-Payment debt age is 1095 days or more, the Three-Payment long-age reduction of 5.0 percentage points applies; where it is at least 730 days but under 1095 days, the Three-Payment mid-age reduction of 2.5 points applies; a Three-Payment debt age under 730 days carries no age reduction.

## Bands

| Band | Debt age on the offer date | Reduction in pricing the Three-Payment offer |
|---|---|---|
| Long age | 1095 calendar days or more | 5.0 percentage points |
| Mid age | 730 calendar days or more, under 1095 | 2.5 percentage points |
| Under 730 | fewer than 730 calendar days | none |

## Hypothetical edge readings

- 1095 days: long age, 5.0 points. 1094 days: mid age, 2.5 points.
- 730 days: mid age, 2.5 points. 729 days: no age reduction.
- A debt age falls in one band only, so the two figures are never taken together.
